verdict.rationale: Context.dev is an API-first product with an official CLI explicitly documented for terminal use and "JSON responses in scripts or CI" (docs-14, probe-4), plus Python and TypeScript SDKs, scoped restricted API keys for integrations, async batch jobs, and documented deadline and rate-limit handling, all of which suit unattended automation. missing for 10: CI-specific setup details (non-interactive auth via env vars, exit codes, pipeline examples) beyond a one-line CLI mention, and independent hands-on corroboration of headless/CI use.
